# statusdrift_on_call_schedule (Resource)

Manages a StatusDrift on-call schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statusdrift_on_call_schedule" "primary" {
  name              = "Primary On-Call"
  timezone          = "America/New_York"
  frequency         = "weekly"
  rotation_interval = 1
  starts_at         = "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  enabled           = true
  participant_ids   = [1, 2, 3]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `frequency` (String) Rotation frequency: daily or weekly.
- `name` (String) The name of the on-call schedule (max 255 characters).
- `participant_ids` (List of Number) Ordered list of organization member IDs in the rotation. Order determines rotation position.
- `rotation_interval` (Number) Number of frequency units per rotation (e.g. 1 = every day/week, 2 = every other).
- `starts_at` (String) When the schedule becomes active, in ISO 8601 format.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone for the schedule (e.g. America/New_York, UTC).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the on-call schedule is active.
- `monitor_group_id` (Number) The monitor group ID this schedule is scoped to. Required when scope_type is monitor_group.
- `scope_type` (String) Schedule scope: org_default (organization-wide) or monitor_group (scoped to a specific group).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the on-call schedule.
